rules.description: Quantity must be a positive integer.

impact.reason: Zero or negative quantities invalidate the order line.
Negative pricing would distort revenue calculations.
Negative discounts would increase billed amount incorrectly.

rules.rule: (order_items.item_discount IS NULL OR order_items.quantity IS NULL OR order_items.unit_price IS NULL OR order_items.item_discount <= order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price)
rules.description: Discount cannot exceed the line's gross subtotal.

impact.reason: Over‑discounting creates negative or unrealistic line totals.

rules.rule: (order_items.line_amount IS NULL OR order_items.quantity IS NULL OR order_items.unit_price IS NULL OR order_items.item_discount IS NULL OR order_items.line_amount = order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price - order_items.item_discount)
rules.description: Line amount must equal quantity × unit_price − discount.

impact.reason: Incorrect line totals affect billing and financial reporting.
Negative line totals indicate data or calculation errors.
